2607.21075.title: VibeVoice-ASR-BitNet Technical Report
2607.21075.paper_summary: We present VibeVoice-ASR-BitNet, a compressed variant of VibeVoice-ASR optimized for real-time inference on edge CPUs. We apply heterogeneous quantization tailored to the computational characteristics of each stage: the VAE acoustic tokenizer uses full-pipeline INT8 quantization (I8_S) with kernel fusion and SIMD optimization, while the autoregressive language model adopts BitNet-style ternary weights (I2_S). To preserve accuracy under aggressive compression, we employ a progressive quantization-aware training strategy. For inference, we implement custom SIMD kernels and fused operators within the ggml framework targeting both ARM and x86 platforms, achieving real-time recognition with RTF < 1 using as few as 3 CPU threads. VibeVoice-ASR-BitNet is 1.6-2.3x faster than Whisper.cpp at comparable model sizes (~1.6 GB), with only modest accuracy degradation compared to the FP16 baseline.
2607.21075.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了 VibeVoice-ASR-BitNet，這是一個針對邊緣 CPU 的即時推斷優化的 VibeVoice-ASR 壓縮變體。<lb/>我們應用針對每個階段計算特徵量身定制的異構量化：VAE 音頻標記器使用全管道 INT8 量化 (I8_S)，並結合內核融合和 SIMD 優化，而自回歸語言模型則採用 BitNet 風格的三元權重 (I2_S)。<lb/>為了在激進壓縮下保持準確性，我們採用了漸進式量化感知訓練策略。<lb/>在推斷中，我們在 ggml 框架內實現了自定義 SIMD 核心和融合運算元，針對 ARM 和 x86 平台，實現了 RTF < 1 的即時識別，使用的 CPU 線程少至 3 個。<lb/>VibeVoice-ASR-BitNet 在可比較的模型大小 (~1.6 GB) 下比 Whisper.cpp 快 1.6-2.3 倍，與 FP16 基準相比，準確性僅有適度下降。
